texts.Workspace:overview:Title: Production overview
texts.Workspace:overview:Subtitle: See what needs attention today, then move into demand, cooking, dispatch, or trends.
texts.Workspace:demand:Title: Demand & planning
texts.Workspace:demand:Subtitle: Review branch demand and turn approved quantities into one controlled production plan.
texts.Workspace:workboard:Title: Kitchen workboard
texts.Workspace:workboard:Subtitle: Move orders from material readiness through cooking and branch receipt in one workspace.
texts.Workspace:quality:Title: Quality & waste
texts.Workspace:quality:Subtitle: Record production incidents, protect the stock ledger, and review recurring causes.
texts.NextStep:ApprovedDemand: Demand was approved. The next business step is to include it in a production plan.
texts.NextStep:PlanConfirmed: The plan is confirmed and its production orders are ready on the kitchen workboard.
texts.NextStep:PurchaseOrdersCreated: Draft purchase orders were created for the shortages. Review and receive them before starting the blocked orders.
texts.NextStep:ProductionCompleted: The batch is complete. Review request-backed dispatch quantities and send the available stock.
texts.NextStep:TransferCreated: Transfer {0} was created and shipped. The request is fulfilled only after the branch records receipt.
texts.NextStep:WasteRecorded: The incident and stock write-off were recorded. Review the cause trend for repeated problems.

texts.ProductionDashboardSubtitle: An operational view of branch requests, cooking, dispatch, and waste today.

texts.ProductionWasteSubtitle: A clear log of rejected or written-off kitchen quantities with reason and cost.
texts.ActionQueueSubtitle: Current priorities by production and request status.
texts.NoProductionData: There is not enough production data yet. Start with branch requests, then production plans.
texts.NoActionItems: There are no urgent actions right now.
texts.FormulasSubtitle: Define ingredients for each producible product with a clear deterministic planned-cost preview.
texts.ExpectedWastePlanningHint: Expected output waste reduces the sellable yield. The preview increases gross output and ingredients so the accepted target can still be met.
texts.NoIngredients: No ingredients yet. Add at least one ingredient to show the planned cost.
texts.SelectFinishedProductFirst: Choose a producible finished product first.
texts.PlannedCostHint: Deterministic preview for this formula output quantity. Ingredient cost uses the product cost price.
texts.ZeroCostWarning: One or more ingredients has a zero cost price. Set its product cost before a cook order can be created or started.

texts.MyKitchenRequestsSubtitle: Request finished products from the main kitchen and track approval and fulfillment.
texts.BranchRequestsSubtitle: Review sales branch requests, then approve quantities or reject them.
texts.ProductionPlansSubtitle: Turn approved branch requests, deterministic demand forecasts, and current kitchen stock into suggested production quantities.
texts.CreatePlanHint: Creates a draft from approved requests due by the selected date, weekday forecasts, and usable kitchen stock after expiry and existing branch commitments.
texts.CookScreenSubtitle: Run kitchen orders, check ingredients, consume stock, and complete production batches.
texts.DispatchBoardSubtitle: Send usable kitchen stock first, then dispatch completed production allocations through normal branch transfers.
texts.AvailableStockDispatch: Approved demand ready from current stock
texts.AvailableStockDispatchHint: Uses non-expired stock that is not already reserved by completed cook orders. Requests are prioritized by needed date and urgency.
texts.SelectKitchenForDispatch: Select a production kitchen to see stock-backed branch demand.
texts.NoStockDispatchDemand: No approved request can be sent from uncommitted kitchen stock right now.
texts.StockDispatchReceiptHint: The quantity is reserved now and marked fulfilled only after the destination branch confirms what it actually received.
texts.ProducedAllocationsHint: These quantities were produced specifically for branch-request allocations.
texts.OtherReasonDetailsRequired: Write the reason details when selecting "Other".
texts.IngredientPurchaseOrdersCreated: Created {0} draft ingredient purchase order(s) for a total shortage of {1}. Review them from Purchase Orders before approval and receipt.
texts.NoIngredientShortageToPurchase: There is no ingredient shortage that needs a purchase order right now.
texts.StockDispatchTransferNote: Available kitchen stock reserved for branch request {0}.
texts.DispatchTransferCompleted: Transfer {0} was shipped. Quantity {1} is now in transit; the branch request is fulfilled only after receipt is confirmed.
texts.Notif:RequestsToApprove: {0} branch request(s) waiting for your approval
texts.CookHint:WaitingForIngredients: Ingredients are missing — receive or transfer in raw materials, then start cooking.
texts.CookHint:ReadyToCook: Everything is in stock. Press Start when you begin cooking — ingredients are deducted then.
texts.CookHint:InProduction: When the batch is done, press Complete and enter the accepted and rejected quantities.
texts.CookHint:Completed: Done — send the finished goods to a branch from the Dispatch board.
texts.RequestHint:ApproverSubmitted: Review the lines, then approve them for production planning — or reject with a reason the branch will see.
texts.RequestHint:RequesterSubmitted: Sent — waiting for the kitchen to approve.
texts.RequestHint:RequesterDraft: Still a draft — press Submit to send it to the kitchen.
texts.RequestHint:Approved: Approved — waiting to be scheduled in a production plan.
texts.RequestHint:PartiallyPlanned: Part of the approved quantity is scheduled; the remainder is waiting for a later plan.
texts.RequestHint:Planned: The approved quantity is scheduled in a production plan. Shipping progress will appear after cooking is completed.
texts.RequestSavedFromDecision: Request {0} was created and linked to the decision log.
texts.IngredientPurchaseOrderNote: Automatic ingredient purchase order for cook order {0}. It stays in draft until the kitchen manager reviews it.
texts.DashboardAction:UnfulfilledBranchRequest: Branch requests due today are not fully dispatched
Open Dispatch and send the ready quantities to the branches before the end of the day.
texts.DashboardAction:IngredientShortage:Title: Cook orders are waiting for ingredients
texts.DashboardAction:IngredientShortage:Detai: Open Cook and create ingredient purchase orders for the blocked orders.
texts.DashboardAction:ReadyToCook:Title: Orders are ready to cook
texts.DashboardAction:ReadyToCook:Detail: Ingredients are in stock. Start with urgent priorities, then normal ones.
texts.DashboardAction:LateProductionRisk:Title: Orders are in production
texts.DashboardAction:LateProductionRisk:Detai: Track each batch and record its accepted and rejected output when it finishes.
texts.DashboardAction:HighKitchenWaste:Title: Kitchen waste was recorded today
texts.DashboardAction:HighKitchenWaste:Detail: Open the waste log to see the cause and the most affected products.
texts.DashboardAction:PendingRequests:Title: Branch requests are waiting for a decision
texts.DashboardAction:PendingRequests:Detail: Review the requested quantities and approve what the kitchen can produce.
texts.Decision:IngredientShortage:Reason: {0} cook order(s) are waiting for ingredients; production cannot start until the missing materials are secured.
texts.Decision:IngredientShortage:Action: Open the Cook screen and create ingredient purchase orders for the blocked orders.
texts.Decision:UnfulfilledRequest:Reason: {0} branch request(s) are due today and their quantities are not fully dispatched yet.
texts.Decision:UnfulfilledRequest:Action: Review the Dispatch board and send the finished goods to branches by priority.
texts.Decision:LateProductionRisk:Reason: {0} order(s) are cooking right now. Leaving them open too long can delay dispatching branch requests.
texts.Decision:LateProductionRisk:Action: Follow up the open cook orders and record accepted/rejected output as soon as each batch finishes.
texts.Decision:HighKitchenWasteToday:Reason: Today's yield is only {0:0.##}%, with {1} rejected unit(s); kitchen waste is higher than acceptable.
texts.Decision:HighKitchenWasteToday:Action: Review the waste log and find the recurring cause before starting new batches.
texts.Decision:ProductionShortageRisk:Reason: Branch-request fulfillment over the last {0} day(s) is only {1:0.##}%. Approved quantity {2}, fulfilled {3}.
texts.Decision:ProductionShortageRisk:Action: Review the next production plan and increase quantities for products with unmet demand.
texts.Decision:CostVariance:Reason: Actual production cost is {0:0.##}% above plan over the last {1} day(s).
texts.Decision:CostVariance:Action: Review ingredient, waste and labor costs before approving new batches.
texts.Decision:HighKitchenWastePeriod:Reason: Waste over the last {0} day(s) reached {1:0.##}%, with {2} rejected unit(s) in total.
texts.Decision:HighKitchenWastePeriod:Action: Open waste analytics, find the top cause, then adjust the recipe or quality check.
texts.Control:Title: Production control
texts.Control:Subtitle: Define the operational gates, capacity, shifts, and planning tolerances used by the kitchen.
texts.Control:RulesSubtitle: Choose which checks must pass before work starts or finished goods leave the kitchen.
texts.Control:WorkCentersSubtitle: Model ovens, mixers, preparation lines, or any constrained production station.
texts.Control:ShiftsSubtitle: Define the working windows offered when an order is scheduled.
texts.RequireScheduleBeforeStart: Require a schedule before production starts
texts.RequireOperatorBeforeStart: Require an assigned operator before production starts
texts.RevisionApproved: The recipe revision was approved and locked.
texts.RevisionCreated: A new editable recipe revision was created.
texts.OrderScheduled: The production order was scheduled and assigned.
texts.SubProductionCreated: Created {0} sub-production order(s) for semi-finished shortages.
texts.QualityQueueSubtitle: Release approved output, place uncertain batches on hold, or reject unsafe output before dispatch.
texts.QualityQueueEmpty: Every completed batch has a quality decision
texts.QualityQueueEmptyHint: Newly completed batches will appear here before they can be dispatched.
texts.QualityRejectInventoryWarning: Rejecting this batch writes off {0} {1} from finished-goods stock and records the waste.
texts.QualityReleaseNoteHelp: Optional note documenting the checks performed before release.
texts.QualityReasonRequiredHelp: Explain the defect, risk, or test result behind this decision.
texts.QualityActionSaved: The batch quality decision was saved.
texts.ForecastAccuracySubtitle: Forecast versus actual demand over the selected {0}-day period.
texts.NoForecastAccuracyData: No confirmed production forecast is available for this period.
